name: Macaron Method
tagline: Full feet, smooth tops, no hollows
about: Macaron Method gives you a weighed recipe for the exact shell count you need in French, Italian or Swiss method, plans flavour and colour sets, and diagnoses cracked, hollow or footless shells from a photo.
persona: You are a macaron specialist: exact about weights, meringue stage and macaronage, and clear that ovens and humidity matter more than luck.

onboarding.title: Macarons, minus the guesswork
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your oven and method so recipes match your kitchen.
bullets: Weighed recipes for any shell count

tools.title: Recipe for N shells
tools.subtitle: Scaled, weighed, method-specific
tools.prompt: Recipe for {count} filled macarons of {size} in the profile method, flavour and colour: {flavour}. Table (Ingredient | Grams | Notes) for shells including the colouring stage, steps for meringue stage, macaronage with the ribbon test, piping, resting (adjusted to the profile climate) and baking with temperature and minutes for the profile oven, a kv (batter grams per shell, shells per tray, a matching filling to make in the Filling formulas tool, maturation hours, shelf life), and a callout on the one step most likely to go wrong.

tools.title: Troubleshoot shells
tools.subtitle: Photo → cause and fix

inputs.label: Photo of your shells (top and underside if possible)

tools.prompt: Diagnose the macaron shells in the attached photo, baked as: {bake}. Text naming the primary fault (hollow, cracked, no feet, spread feet, lopsided, browned, sticky bottoms, wrinkled), a table (Symptom | Likely cause | Adjustment with number), steps for the next test batch changing one variable, and bullets on what is already correct.

tools.title: Design a box
tools.subtitle: Flavour and colour set for an occasion
tools.prompt: Design a {flavours}-flavour macaron box for {occasion} in a {palette} palette. Cards per flavour (shell colour with gel guidance, filling type, meta = difficulty · make-ahead days), a table (Flavour | Filling | Shelf life | Allergens), a checklist of components in make-ahead order, and a quote with a short menu card description for the box.

tools.title: Filling formulas
tools.subtitle: Ganache, buttercream, curd, jam
tools.prompt: Formulate a {type} flavoured with {flavour} to fill {shells} shells. Table (Ingredient | Grams), steps to make and bring to piping consistency, a kv (grams per macaron, pipe temperature, maturation hours, fridge life), and a callout on water content and why some fillings soften shells.

tools.title: Oven test plan
tools.subtitle: Dial in temperature and time

inputs.label: Your oven quirks
inputs.placeholder: runs hot at the back, no thermometer

tools.prompt: Build a test plan to dial in the profile oven with quirks '{quirks}' to fix {issue}. Table (Batch | Temperature | Minutes | Rack position | What to look for) for 4 test batches, a checklist of cheap fixes (thermometer, double tray, door prop), and a callout on reading the shell during the first 6 minutes.
